For the most up-to-date health research findings, top outlets to check directly include:

  • ScienceDaily (Health Section) ([sciencedaily.com/news/health_medicine](https://sciencedaily.com/news/health_medicine)) – Aggregates peer-reviewed findings and press releases from medical journals and research universities daily.

  • Medical Xpress (medicalxpress.com) – Tracks clinical trials, neuroscience updates, and public health studies as they break.

  • Nature Medicine & The Lancet News ([nature.com/nm](https://nature.com/nm), thelancet.com) – High-impact clinical research summaries and global health policy reports.
